reasons.plausibility: Thorough mechanistic reasoning aligns well with established principles of kinetics and diffusion in multimetal systems.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparison of two thermal profiles with all else held constant is a clear, direct way to prove or falsify the role of reduction and interdiffusion rates.
reasons.usefulness: It provides straightforward experimental guidance for controlling high-entropy alloy nanoparticle synthesis conditions to achieve homogeneity.
